name: FrenchKiss
source: At the heart of Paris, dive into the history of Sekai and become the master of her destiny. When the maze of this romantic city meet the one of her heart, many options will be available to her as well as to you in order to find the one true love.
translation: 在巴黎市中心，深入了解世界的历史并成为她命运的主人。当这座浪漫城市的迷宫遇到她的心上人时，她和你都会有多种选择来找到真爱。
